title: The Hidden Protection
summary: Ha-Jun realizes every miraculous lucky escape and anonymous guardian intervention in his youth was Tae-Jun operating from the shadows through Kuro.

panels.shot: chimera prime lunging with four chainsaw blades spinning
panels.action: The 15-foot Chimera Prime rockets across the frozen floor at 100 mph, all four titanium-toothed chainsaw arms roaring.
panels.prose_en: The 15-foot Chimera Prime rockets across the frozen floor at 100 mph, all four titanium-toothed chainsaw arms roaring.
panels.prose_hi: Jame hue farsh par 100 meal prati ghante ki gati se 15 foot ka chimera prime rocket, sabhi char titenium-daantedar chainsaw hathiyar garjana kar rahe han.

panels.shot: chainsaw blades slashing down at ha-jun skull
panels.action: Four whirling blades converge from all four angles simultaneously to mince Ha-Jun into red pulp.
panels.prose_en: Four whirling blades converge from all four angles simultaneously to mince Ha-Jun into red pulp.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ko lal gude mein badalne ke liye char ghumne wale blade ek saath sabhi char konon se ekatrit hote han.

panels.shot: ha-jun sidestepping at mach 3 leaving afterimage
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his head three inches; the blades shear through his shadow afterimage, biting into empty air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tilts his head three inches; the blades shear through his shadow afterimage, biting into empty air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna sir teen inch jhukata hai; blade uski chhaya ke madhyam se khali hawa mein kaatate hue katarate han.

panels.shot: chainsaw blades smashing into concrete floor shattering foundation
panels.action: The four blades bite five feet deep into the reinforced bedrock, spraying sparks, shattered rebar, and granite rubble.
panels.prose_en: The four blades bite five feet deep into the reinforced bedrock, spraying sparks, shattered rebar, and granite rubble.
panels.prose_hi: Char blade prabalit chattan mein paanch feet gahrai tak chhed karte han, jisse chingari, tuti hui sariya aur granite ka malba nikalta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing on the beast upper arm lightly like a bird
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands weightlessly balanced upon the monster's left shoulder hydraulic casing, coat rustling.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Too slow. Mere samne tum sirf ek machine ho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands weightlessly balanced upon the monster's left shoulder hydraulic casing, coat rustling.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun rakshas ke baen kandhe ke hydraulic aavaran, coat sarsrahat par bharahin roop se santulit khada hai.

panels.shot: beast swiveling cybernetic head firing plasma blast from mouth
panels.action: The monster's chest vents pop open; an incandescent beam of green plasma erupts straight at Ha-Jun's face.
panels.prose_en: The monster's chest vents pop open; an incandescent beam of green plasma erupts straight at Ha-Jun's face.
panels.prose_hi: Rakshs ki chhati khul jaati hai; hare plasma ki ek garmagaram kiran sidhe Ha-Jun ke chehre par footati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting eclipse devourer swallowing the plasma
panels.action: The Eclipse Devourer relic opens a miniature black hole before Ha-Jun's palm, absorbing the million-degree beam completely.
panels.prose_en: The Eclipse Devourer relic opens a miniature black hole before Ha-Jun's palm, absorbing the million-degree beam completely.
panels.prose_hi: Aclips davoorer avashesh Ha-Jun ki hatheli ke samne ek laghu black hole kholta hai, jo milion-degri kiran ko puri tarah se avshoshit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing sanguine fang with devastating downward slice
panels.action: Ha-Jun unsheathes the flaming Sanguine Fang in a reverse grip and plunges it into the cyber-spine.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun unsheathes the flaming Sanguine Fang in a reverse grip and plunges it into the cyber-spine.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne jwalant senguin fang ko reverse grip mein khol diya aur use cyber-rearh mein daal diya.

panels.shot: dark violet hellfire erupting through the beast internal circuits
panels.action: Black and purple flames burst from the monster's hydraulic seams, eyes, and joints, cooking the synthetic core from inside.
panels.prose_en: Black and purple flames burst from the monster's hydraulic seams, eyes, and joints, cooking the synthetic core from inside.
panels.prose_hi: Rakshs ke hydraulic sim, aankhon aur jodon se kali aur baingani rang ki laptein footati han, jo andar se synthetic core ko pakaati han.

panels.shot: all four beast arms detaching and clattering to the ice
panels.action: With four clean hydraulic snaps, the monstrous arms shear off at the shoulders, falling into the ice.
panels.prose_en: With four clean hydraulic snaps, the monstrous arms shear off at the shoulders, falling into the ice.
panels.prose_hi: Char swachh hydraulic snap ke sath, shaitani demonic bhujaen kandhon se takraakar barf mein gir jaati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun backflipping gracefully onto the ice floor
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands with surgical poise thirty feet away, flicking black demonic oil off the edge of his blood katana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands with surgical poise thirty feet away, flicking black demonic oil off the edge of his blood katana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun tees feet door surgical santulan ke saath utarta hai, aur apne khoon katana ke kinare se kala shaitani demonic tel nikalta hai.

panels.shot: chimera prime collapsing face-first into the frozen water
panels.action: The fifteen-foot monstrosity topples forward like a felled oak tree, its cybernetic core smoking and dying.
panels.prose_en: The fifteen-foot monstrosity topples forward like a felled oak tree, its cybernetic core smoking and dying.
panels.prose_hi: Pandrah foot ki vishalta kate hue oak ke ped ki tarah aage ki or girti hai, iska cybernetic core dhumrapan aur mar raha hai.

panels.shot: vance on the monitor staring with jaw hanging slack
panels.action: On the giant wall screen, Dr. Vance drops his wine glass; it shatters on his private office floor.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: In twelve seconds?! Chimera Prime defeated an entire S-rank raid party last month!

panels.prose_en: On the giant wall screen, Dr. Vance drops his wine glass; it shatters on his private office floor.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal deewar screen par, do. vens apna wine glass girate han; yah unke niji karyalay ke farsh par bikhar gaya.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking toward the primary data terminal ignoring the corpse
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't even glance back at the dead beast; he walks straight back to the blinking data terminal.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun doesn't even glance back at the dead beast; he walks straight back to the blinking data terminal.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun mrit janwar ki or mudkar bhi nahin dekhta; wah sidhe blinking data terminal par wapas chala jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto the keyboard typing with mystical talons
panels.action: Kuro taps four specific keys, entering an encrypted access string: 'TAE-JUN-SHIELD-07'.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun left an uncorrupted partition on this mainframe. Look.

panels.prose_en: Kuro taps four specific keys, entering an encrypted access string: 'TAE-JUN-SHIELD-07'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro char vishisht kunjiyon ko tap karta hai, ek encrypted access string mein pravesh karta hai: 'TAE-JUN-SHIELD-07'.

panels.shot: new terminal folder opening: 'LITTLE BROTHER WATCH REPORT'
panels.action: A secret folder marked with a padlock icon opens, revealing hundreds of dated diary entries spanning six years.
panels.prose_en: A secret folder marked with a padlock icon opens, revealing hundreds of dated diary entries spanning six years.
panels.prose_hi: Padlock icon se chinhit ek gupt folder khulta hai, jisme chhah varshon ki saikadon dinankit diary pravistiyan samne aati han.

panels.shot: flashback shard 1: middle school alleyway bully ambush
panels.action: Flashback: 13-year-old Ha-Jun cornered in an alley by three high school delinquents with wooden bats.
panels.prose_en: 13-year-old Ha-Jun cornered in an alley by three high school delinquents with wooden bats.
panels.prose_hi: 13 varshiya Ha-Jun ko high school ke teen apradhiyon ne lakdi ke ballon se ek gali mein gher liya.

panels.shot: flashback shard 1 resolution: kuro shadowy talon in the night
panels.action: From the rooftop above, a black bird's shadow flits; the bullies' bats suddenly split in half mysteriously and they flee in terror.

dialogue.text: Class 7 mein jab bullies ne ghera tha... Mujhe laga tha wo darr kar bhaag gaye.

panels.prose_en: From the rooftop above, a black bird's shadow flits; the bullies' bats suddenly split in half mysteriously and they flee in terror.
panels.prose_hi: Upar chhat se ek kali chidiya ki chhaya udti hai; badmashon ke chamgadad achanak rahasyamay tarike se aadhe hisse mein bant gaye aur ve darkar bhag gaye.

panels.shot: flashback shard 2: hospital bed with mysterious paid bill
panels.action: Flashback: 14-year-old Ha-Jun hospitalized with severe pneumonia, the nurse handing him a receipt stamped 'PAID IN FULL - ANONYMOUS BENEFACTOR'.

dialogue.text: Mera hospital bill... 50 lakh won... Jo mysterious donor ne pay kiya tha.

panels.prose_en: 14-year-old Ha-Jun hospitalized with severe pneumonia, the nurse handing him a receipt stamped 'PAID IN FULL - ANONYMOUS BENEFACTOR'.
panels.prose_hi: 14 varshiya Ha-Jun ko gambhir nimoniya ke karan aspataal mein bharti karaya gaya, nurse ne use ek rasid di jis par 'pura bhugtan - agyat labharthi' likha hua tha.

panels.shot: terminal log showing tae-jun trading his blood for medical funds
panels.action: Terminal log: 'Subject Zero volunteered for high-risk marrow extraction in exchange for anonymous bank transfer to Seoul National Hospital.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera ilaaj karwane ke liye... Usne apni bone marrow bechi...

panels.prose_en: Terminal log: 'Subject Zero volunteered for high-risk marrow extraction in exchange for anonymous bank transfer to Seoul National Hospital.'.
panels.prose_hi: Torminal log: 'sabject zero ne seoul national hospital mein gumnaam bank hastantaran ke badle mein uchch jokhim wale majja nishkarshan ke liye swechha se kaam kiya.'

panels.shot: ha-jun clutching his chest in overwhelming heartbreak
panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches his chest over his beating heart; his knees tremble as the sheer weight of Tae-Jun's love crushes his breath.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kitna bada pagal tha wo... Mere liye itna sab kuch saha aur ek baar bhi nahi bola...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutches his chest over his beating heart; his knees tremble as the sheer weight of Tae-Jun's love crushes his breath.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne dhadkate dil ko apni chhati se pakad liya; uske ghutne kampane lagte hain kyonki Tae-Jun ke pyar ka bhari bojh uski sanson ko kuchal deta hai.

panels.shot: kuro gently nudging ha-jun cheek with his soft feather wing
panels.action: Kuro folds his raven wing against Ha-Jun's wet cheek: 'He was proud of you every single day, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Jab bhi main usse milne Tartarus ki border pe jaata tha, he only asked: 'Is Ha-Jun eating well? Is he studying?'

panels.prose_en: Kuro folds his raven wing against Ha-Jun's wet cheek: 'He was proud of you every single day, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne Ha-Jun ke gile gaal par apna kaua pankh moda: 'use har din tum par garv hota tha, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun closing his eyes taking a deep, shuddering breath
panels.action: Ha-Jun closes his eyes; the tears stop. His breath stabilizes into a deep, rhythmic monastic calm.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun closes his eyes; the tears stop. His breath stabilizes into a deep, rhythmic monastic calm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni aankhen band kar lin; aansu ruk jaate han. uski saans ek gahri, laybaddh mathvasi shanti mein sthir ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes: irises glowing with unshakeable conviction
panels.action: His eyes open: steady, razor-sharp, burning with pure royal authority and love.
panels.prose_en: His eyes open: steady, razor-sharp, burning with pure royal authority and love.
panels.prose_hi: Uski aankhen khulti han: sthir, ustra-tej, shuddh shahi adhikar aur prem se jalti hui.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at vance on the wall monitor
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks Vance directly in his cybernetic eye: 'Vance. Where is the gate to Tartarus?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Vance. Aakhri baar pooch raha hoon. Tartarus ka portal kahan hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks Vance directly in his cybernetic eye: 'Vance. Where is the gate to Tartarus?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun vens ko sidhe apni cybernetic aankh mein dekhta hai: 'vence. tarters ka dwar kahan hai?'

panels.shot: vance sneering sweating nervously on camera
panels.action: Vance loosens his tie, sweat beading on his forehead: 'Even if I tell you, Tartarus is the Void Primordial's seat! You can't enter without dying!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: You fool! Tartarus is governed by the Three Void Sovereigns! They will dismantle your soul!

panels.prose_en: Vance loosens his tie, sweat beading on his forehead: 'Even if I tell you, Tartarus is the Void Primordial's seat! You can't enter without dying!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vence ne apni tie dhili kar di, uske mathe par pasina aa gaya: 'bhale hi main aapko bataun, tarters shunya primordial ki seat hai! aap bina mare pravesh nahin kar sakte!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing blood blade and pointing it at camera
panels.action: Ha-Jun aims the glowing tip of the Sanguine Fang right at the camera lens: 'I killed the First Sovereign in my mindscape. Your Three Sovereigns are just meat.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main Asmodaius ko hara chuka hoon. Tumhare Void Sovereigns mere liye sirf raaste ka pathar hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun aims the glowing tip of the Sanguine Fang right at the camera lens: 'I killed the First Sovereign in my mindscape. Your Three Sovereigns are just meat.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne camere ke lens par senguin fang ki chamakti nok ka lakshya rakha hai: 'maine apne mindscap mein pehle Sovereign ko maar dala. aapki teen prabhusattaen keval maans han.'

panels.shot: baek extracting coordinates from the decrypted terminal disk
panels.action: Baek yanks a flash drive from the port: 'I got it! The primary interdimensional portal is located under Incheon Subsea Tunnel Shaft 4!'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Shaft 4! The abandoned undersea rail tunnel between Incheon and Yeongjong Island!

panels.prose_en: Baek yanks a flash drive from the port: 'I got it! The primary interdimensional portal is located under Incheon Subsea Tunnel Shaft 4!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne bandargah se ek flash drive khinchi: 'mujhe mil gaya! prathmik antaayami portal inchiyon sabasi tunnel shaft 4!' ke antargat sthit hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun smashing the wall monitor with a single mana flick
panels.action: Ha-Jun flicks his index finger; a shockwave of violet mana shatters the giant wall monitor into sparking glass shards.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flicks his index finger; a shockwave of violet mana shatters the giant wall monitor into sparking glass shards.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni tarjani hilata hai; baingani maina ki ek shockwev vishal deewar monitor ko sparkling glass ke tukdon mein tod deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning toward the exit tunnel with squad behind him
panels.action: Ha-Jun turns toward the exit tunnel, coat billowing, Kuro perched proudly on his shoulder: 'Let's go get my brother.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Shaft 4 chalo. Hum apne bhai ko ghar wapas laane ja rahe hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns toward the exit tunnel, coat billowing, Kuro perched proudly on his shoulder: 'Let's go get my brother.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun nikas surang ki or mudta hai, coat lahrata hai, Kuro garv se uske kandhe par baitha hai: 'chalo mere bhai ko le aao.'
